items.title: Meta's Muse raises personal info concerns, how investors can leverage volatility
items.summary: In the latest Market Hang, Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on the state of the AI race after Meta Platforms (META) released its new Muse chatbot, their sentiments around the latest market rally, and much more. Today's panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, tockBrokers.com director of investor research Jessica Inskip, and The Wealth Consulting Group chief market strategist Talley Léger.

items.summary: Shares of financial marketplace platform LendingTree (NASDAQ:TREE) fell 7.4% in the afternoon session after the Wall Street Journal reported that Meta’s Muse can buy goods online, respond to emails, and complete other tasks a user authorizes.
